label: The Treaty Night
summary: You are the mortal envoy sent to renew the Night Treaty with the vampire houses. One house wants it broken; another's heir wants you.
title: The Treaty Night
description: Every fifty years a mortal envoy renews the Night Treaty before the Velvet Court. This year the envoy is you. You have seven nights of balls, audiences and negotiations. House Varn wants the treaty broken, House Sorel will support it for a price, and the heir of House Sorel has asked for you by name.

chapterOutlines.title: The Masked Ball
chapterOutlines.outline: Present your credentials at the Court's welcome ball.

chapterOutlines.title: Seven Nights
chapterOutlines.outline: Negotiate with the houses, collect favors and learn their secrets.

chapterOutlines.title: The Betrayal
chapterOutlines.outline: Discover who intends to break the treaty, and how.

chapterOutlines.title: The Renewal
chapterOutlines.outline: Stand before the Court and make your choice.

scene.location: The Palazzo Sorel's ballroom, at midnight, on the first night of the renewal
scene.summary: A thousand candles and not one mirror. The Court turns, as one, to look at you. Somewhere a violin stops.

openThreads: What happened to the last envoy?
What does the heir of House Sorel really want?

npcs.name: Lucien Sorel
npcs.description: The heir of House Sorel, four hundred years old and bored of all of it, until you arrived.
goals: Escape his mother's plans for him

npcs.name: Lady Isadora Varn
npcs.description: The head of House Varn, who remembers when vampires ruled openly and would very much like those days back.
goals: Break the treaty without breaking the letter of it

npcs.name: Tomas Reyes
npcs.description: Your mortal secretary and oldest friend, who has a stake in his sleeve and a flask of garlic wine in his coat.

items.name: Sealed treaty
items.description: The Night Treaty, three centuries old, waiting for one more signature.

items.name: Silver ring
items.description: Your grandmother's ring. Vampires do not like to shake the hand that wears it.
